waive.TypeOK: Structural domain check only; behavioral mutations target the eight frozen protocol obligations.

mutations.name: ack-before-receiver-ownership
mutations.why: Treat a Missing canonical lookup as success before source and receiver Disk ownership.

mutations.name: attempted-retry-called-unadmitted
mutations.why: Forget or supersession of an attempted retry must not promise that no delivery happened.

mutations.name: stale-timer-reclaims-superseded-mail
mutations.why: A scheduled unstarted task ignores its exact active handle and completed latch, attempting a forgotten original.
mutations.search:
/\ g \in scheduled
    /\ g \in inFlight
    /\ flights[g].phase = "claimed"
    /\ flights[g].outcome = "none"

mutations.name: admit-duplicate-instead-of-join
mutations.why: Remove the native identity join guard, allowing a second generation for an indexed identity.

mutations.name: known-retry-materializes
mutations.why: An existing receiver lookup is allowed to run carry and land again.

mutations.name: late-return-clears-replacement-slot
mutations.why: An old completion removes the pair slot without comparing its generation.
mutations.search: /\ pending' = (IF pending = g THEN None ELSE pending)

mutations.name: late-return-completes-replacement-waiters
mutations.why: An old result is applied to the currently pending replacement completion rather than its own handle.
mutations.replace: /\ requests' = Settle(IF pending = None THEN g ELSE pending, result, g)

mutations.name: supersede-drops-waiters
mutations.why: Removing the original pending mail without completing its caller strands a terminal unadmitted waiter.

mutations.name: forget-keeps-unadmitted-waiter-waiting
mutations.why: Forget marks a queued flight terminal but leaves its waiter waiting.

mutations.name: conflict-overwrites-original-hash
mutations.why: A conflicting retry replaces the original canonical payload instead of leaving it intact.

mutations.name: active-forget-discards-running-handle
mutations.why: Forget drops a handle while its detached Deliver can still complete.

mutations.name: late-result-overwrites-unknown-latch
mutations.why: A once-completed OutcomeUnknown latch is replaced by a later Deliver outcome.
mutations.search: Effective(g, result) == IF flights[g].outcome = "none" THEN result ELSE flights[g].outcome

mutations.name: forgotten-unstarted-task-clears-new-handle
mutations.why: Drop of an old unstarted task removes a new same-identity active completion without generation and Arc equality.
mutations.replace:
/\ flights' = [flights EXCEPT ![g].phase = "stopped"]
    /\ inFlight' = {n \in inFlight : flights[n].key # flights[g].key}
